name: ENEOS
verdict: Owned by ENEOS Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of ENEOS Holdings, Inc., which is listed in Tokyo and Nagoya. Nothing found.
note: Official Sponsor of the Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP team: ENEOS USA's MotoGP page says it 'proudly sponsors Yamaha Factory Racing, working with the Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP team', and the logo is listed under Official Sponsors on the team's official sponsors page (2026). Rating note: no state holder identified and no human-rights finding against ENEOS located; NGOs criticised its part in Myanmar's Yetagun gas project, from which it announced its withdrawal in 2022 (criticism, not a finding).
